Common.BasedInGeneva: Ridger is based in Geneva and works with families across Switzerland.
Common.ServicesTitle: What we do for your family

geneva.Name: Geneva

Hero.Title: Family office in Geneva — close to you, in the heart of the city
Hero.Description: Ridger is a Swiss multi-family office based on boulevard Georges-Favon in Geneva. We bring your wealth into a single view and coordinate your advisers, without managing your assets.

Intro: Geneva is our home base. This is where we welcome families, meet their advisers and follow their affairs day to day.
Our work is digital first: consolidated reporting, a digital vault and online exchanges. But in Geneva, a meeting at our office is always an option.

Sections.Title: Meetings at our office
Sections.Body: We welcome you at our Geneva office for the moments that matter: a first meeting, the annual review of your wealth, family decisions. The rest of the time, you reach us however you prefer.

Sections.Title: Your Geneva advisers, coordinated
Sections.Body: Private banks, independent asset managers, lawyers, notaries: we work with the advisers you already have. We also prepare the documents expected by the Administration fiscale cantonale and follow deadlines with your tax adviser.

Sections.Title: Families from here and elsewhere
Sections.Body: Many Geneva families have ties to several countries. We work in French, English, German, Spanish and Portuguese, and coordinate advisers in Switzerland and abroad.

Closing.Title: Let's talk about your situation
Closing.Body: A first confidential meeting, at our office or by video call, to understand your needs and see how we can help.

Questions.Question: Where is your family office in Geneva?
Questions.Answer: Our office is at 26 Boulevard Georges Favon, 1204 Geneva. We welcome families there for the moments that matter, such as the first meeting, the annual wealth review or family decisions.

Questions.Question: What is a multi-family office?
Questions.Answer: A multi-family office such as Ridger shares its infrastructure, tools and expertise across several families. Ridger brings your wealth together in a single view and coordinates your advisers, without managing your assets.

Questions.Question: Do you work with our current Geneva advisers?
Questions.Answer: Yes: private banks, independent asset managers, lawyers and notaries. We also prepare the documents expected by the Administration fiscale cantonale and track deadlines with your tax adviser.

Questions.Question: Which languages do you work in?
Questions.Answer: French, English, German, Spanish and Portuguese. We coordinate advisers based in Switzerland and abroad.

lausanne.Name: Lausanne

Hero.Title: Family office for families in Lausanne and the canton of Vaud
Hero.Description: From Geneva, Ridger supports families in Vaud: a single view of their wealth, coordination of their advisers and oversight of their administration.

Intro: We are not based in Lausanne, and we prefer to say so plainly. Our office is in Geneva, a short distance away, and the way we work lends itself well to remote support.
A digital platform, consolidated reporting and video calls make up the day-to-day. When it is useful, an in-person meeting can be arranged, including at our Geneva office.

Sections.Title: From Geneva, at your pace
Sections.Body: You follow your wealth online, at any time, and we stay reachable through the channel you prefer. For important reviews, an in-person meeting can be arranged when useful.

Sections.Title: Your Vaud advisers, coordinated
Sections.Body: We work with your current banks, notary, lawyer and fiduciary. We gather the documents needed by the Administration cantonale des impôts (ACI) and follow the calendar with your tax adviser.

Sections.Title: Tax and succession in Vaud
Sections.Body: The taxation of wealth and inheritance differs from one canton to another. These questions are handled with your tax advisers and notary; we make sure they have complete, up-to-date information.

Closing.Title: A first conversation, with no commitment
Closing.Body: By video call or in Geneva, a confidential meeting to review your situation and your priorities.

Questions.Question: Does Ridger have an office in Lausanne?
Questions.Answer: No. Our office is in Geneva, a short distance from Lausanne. We support families in Vaud remotely and arrange an in-person meeting when useful, including at our Geneva office.

Questions.Question: How does Ridger work with a family in Vaud?
Questions.Answer: A digital platform, consolidated reporting and video calls make up the day-to-day. You follow your wealth online, at any time, and we stay reachable through the channel you prefer.

Questions.Question: Do you work with our advisers in Vaud?
Questions.Answer: Yes. We work with your current banks, notary, lawyer and fiduciary, gather the documents needed by the Administration cantonale des impôts (ACI) and follow the calendar with your tax adviser.

Questions.Question: Who handles tax and inheritance matters in Vaud?
Questions.Answer: Your tax advisers and notary, because the taxation of wealth and inheritance differs from one canton to another. We make sure they have complete, up-to-date information.

zurich.Name: Zurich

Hero.Title: Family office for families in Zurich
Hero.Description: Based in Geneva, Ridger supports families in Zurich remotely, with in-person meetings arranged when useful: a single view of their wealth and coordination of their advisers.

Intro: Ridger has no office in Zurich. We work from Geneva with families living elsewhere in Switzerland, with an organisation designed for digital from the start.
Your wealth is consolidated on a secure platform, your documents are kept in a digital vault hosted in Switzerland, and in-person meetings can be arranged when useful.

Sections.Title: Remote by default, in person when useful
Sections.Body: Everyday exchanges happen online and by video call. For an annual review, a family decision or a meeting with your advisers, an in-person meeting can be arranged.

Sections.Title: Your Zurich advisers, coordinated
Sections.Body: We bring in your current banks, asset managers, lawyers and fiduciaries rather than replacing them. For tax, we prepare the documents expected by the Kantonales Steueramt Zürich and coordinate deadlines with your tax adviser.

Sections.Title: In German, French or English
Sections.Body: We work in German, French, English, Spanish and Portuguese. Each family member can speak with us in the language that comes most naturally.

Closing.Title: Let's get acquainted
Closing.Body: A first confidential video call to understand your situation and see whether we can help.

Questions.Question: Does Ridger have an office in Zurich?
Questions.Answer: No. We work from Geneva with families living elsewhere in Switzerland, remotely, and an in-person meeting can be arranged when useful, for example for an annual review or a family decision.

Questions.Question: Can you work in German?
Questions.Answer: Yes. We work in German, French, English, Spanish and Portuguese, and each family member can speak with us in the language that comes most naturally.

Questions.Question: Do you work with our Zurich advisers?
Questions.Answer: Yes. We bring in your current banks, asset managers, lawyers and fiduciaries rather than replacing them, prepare the documents expected by the Kantonales Steueramt Zürich and coordinate deadlines with your tax adviser.

Questions.Question: Do you offer domiciliation in Zurich?
Questions.Answer: No, we have no office in Zurich. Domiciliation of structures and mail management take place in Geneva, including sorting, scanning and follow-up of mail.

zug.Name: Zug

Hero.Title: Family office for families in Zug
Hero.Description: From Geneva, Ridger supports families in the canton of Zug: private wealth and family companies in a single view, with their advisers coordinated.

Intro: Our office is in Geneva; we have no presence in Zug. We support families in Zug remotely, with a digital platform; in-person meetings can be arranged when useful.
Our role is the same everywhere: bring the information together, coordinate the advisers and oversee the administration, without ever managing your assets.

Sections.Title: A remote relationship, well kept
Sections.Body: Online consolidated reporting, a digital vault and video calls set the rhythm. In-person meetings can be arranged when useful.

Sections.Title: Private wealth and family companies
Sections.Body: When the family's wealth includes an operating company or a holding, we keep both sides, private and corporate, easy to read, and coordinate your fiduciary, lawyers and banks.

Sections.Title: Working with the Zug tax administration
Sections.Body: We prepare the documents needed by the Steuerverwaltung des Kantons Zug and follow deadlines with your tax adviser, who remains your contact for any tax question.

Closing.Title: A first confidential meeting
Closing.Body: By video call, to review your wealth, your advisers and what you expect from a family office.

Questions.Question: Does Ridger have an office in Zug?
Questions.Answer: No. Our office is in Geneva and we have no presence in Zug. We support families in Zug remotely, and in-person meetings can be arranged when useful.

Questions.Question: Can you follow both our private wealth and our family company?
Questions.Answer: Yes. When the family's wealth includes an operating company or a holding, we keep both sides, private and corporate, easy to read, and coordinate your fiduciary, lawyers and banks.

Questions.Question: How do you coordinate with the Zug tax administration?
Questions.Answer: We prepare the documents needed by the Steuerverwaltung des Kantons Zug and follow deadlines with your tax adviser, who remains your contact for any tax question.

Questions.Question: Does Ridger manage the family's assets?
Questions.Answer: No. Our role is to bring the information together, coordinate the advisers and oversee the administration, without ever managing your assets.

lugano.Name: Lugano

Hero.Title: Family office for families in Lugano and Ticino
Hero.Description: Based in Geneva, Ridger supports families in Ticino remotely, in coordination with their local advisers; in-person meetings can be arranged when useful.

Intro: We have no office in Ticino. From Geneva, we support families in Lugano and the surrounding region with a digital platform and video calls; in-person meetings can be arranged when useful.
We work in French, English, German, Spanish and Portuguese, but not in Italian. For exchanges in Italian, we rely on your advisers in Ticino.

Sections.Title: From Geneva, in close contact with you
Sections.Body: Your wealth is consolidated online and your documents are kept in a digital vault hosted in Switzerland. For the meetings that matter, an in-person meeting can be arranged.

Sections.Title: Your Ticino advisers, coordinated
Sections.Body: Banks, lawyers, notaries and fiduciaries: we work with the ones you already know. We gather the documents needed by the Divisione delle contribuzioni and follow the calendar with your tax adviser.

Sections.Title: An Italian-speaking setting
Sections.Body: In Ticino, many documents are written in Italian. We bring them into your reporting and digital vault, and your local advisers remain your contacts for exchanges in that language.

Closing.Title: Let's talk about your situation
Closing.Body: A first confidential video call, in whichever of our working languages suits you best.

Questions.Question: Does Ridger have an office in Ticino?
Questions.Answer: No. From Geneva, we support families in Lugano and the surrounding region with a digital platform and video calls, and in-person meetings can be arranged when useful.

Questions.Question: Do you work in Italian?
Questions.Answer: No. We work in French, English, German, Spanish and Portuguese, and rely on your advisers in Ticino for exchanges in Italian.

Questions.Question: What do you do with documents written in Italian?
Questions.Answer: We bring them into your reporting and digital vault. Your local advisers remain your contacts for exchanges in that language.

Questions.Question: Does Ridger manage the wealth of families in Ticino?
Questions.Answer: Ridger does not manage assets. We consolidate your wealth online, coordinate your banks, lawyers, notaries and fiduciaries, and gather the documents needed by the Divisione delle contribuzioni.
